verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a sandbox with endpoints to simulate merchant-acquirer-originated transaction events (authorizations) and mention it mirrors production end-to-end including cards, transactions, and webhooks, but explicit mention of simulating clearings, reversals, refunds, and declines as distinct lifecycle events is not shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation/examples of simulating clearing, reversal, refund, and decline events specifically (only generic 'transaction events' and authorization simulation are cited), independent/hands-on confirmation of full lifecycle simulation.
